sentences.text: ?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:180523
Court No. - 81
Case :- Matters Under Article 227 No. - 1259 of 2023

Petitioner :- Pankaj Kumar And Another
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 4 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Saurabh Pathak

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Ghan Shyam
Hon'ble Mrs. Jyotsna Sharma,J.
1.
Case called out in the revised list.
None responds for the petitioners.
Learned AGA for the State is present.

2. This writ petition under Article 227 of the Constitution has been filed by the petitioners namely,
Pankaj Kumar and Mukesh, with a prayer that the summoning order dated 05.12.2022 and entire proceedings arising out of case crime no. 184 of 2020 under sections 376, 354B, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 of POCSO Act, be quashed.
3.
From the papers on record and submissions of the learned AGA, following facts emerge:-

The respondent no. 5-Babali W/o Devendra Kumar @ Kallu filed an FIR against the petitioners, with the allegation that her daughter (aged about 6 years) was sexually assaulted by the accused persons-Pankaj Kumar and Mukesh (who are petitioners Pankaj Kumar And Another vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31414638/
1 herein).

entities.text: Pankaj Kumar And Another vs State Of U.P. And 4 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The matter was investigated upon and a final report was filed.
On the basis of a protest application, the petitioners have been summoned by an order dated 05.12.2022 after taking cognizance under section 190(1)(3) Cr.P.C. and the case has proceeded further.

4. I perused the material on record viz copy of FIR, the statements of witnesses including the victim,
the medical examination report, the protest petition etc.
Prima facie it appears that the court concerned has proceeded on the basis of material collected by the prosecution.

5. The petitioners have filed this writ petition for quashing the summoning order and entire proceedings, merely on the premise that they have been falsely implicated in this case because of property dispute.
This legal position is settled that defence of the accused cannot be considered at this stage and that they can put, before the court concerned, their submissions, at appropriate stages of the case.
6. There is no good ground to quash the entire proceedings and therefore this petition is dismissed.

Order Date :- 19.9.2023 #Vikram/-
